title: Serial Communication
subtitle: UART debugging, sending data to a computer, and parsing

content.text: Serial is the simplest way to debug Arduino code and exchange data with a computer. The Arduino IDE Serial Monitor connects at the configured baud rate.
Use 115200 baud instead of 9600 for faster data transfer. Both ends must use the same rate.

questions.question: What must match between the Arduino and Serial Monitor?
questions.explanation: Both the Arduino sketch and the Serial Monitor must use the same baud rate, or you will see garbled data.

faq.q: Can I use Serial while also using other libraries?
faq.a: Most libraries are compatible. Watch out for SoftwareSerial conflicts and libraries that disable interrupts, which can corrupt serial data.
